comments.content:
I’m doing error analysis on a somewhat older shared solution, reported around 0.660. My reproduction reached 0.658. I started mainly to understand the system, then explore improvements through its existing representations and decision process.

I captured component scores and intermediate blending stages for all 2,699 training passages, then analyzed expert disagreements, component removals and cases where blending overrides a correct expert. This includes tracing the existing family specialists.

One negative result may be relevant. Removing a Qwen3-14B score head improved the training proxy but lowered my submission score to 0.649. A confidence-based override using the complementary stack scored 0.643 at a 90% threshold and 0.655 at 98%.

My next step is prompt-held-out evaluation of the style components to see which apparent distinctions survive.

comments.raw_markdown:
I’m doing error analysis on a somewhat older shared solution, reported around 0.660. My reproduction reached 0.658. I started mainly to understand the system, then explore improvements through its existing representations and decision process.

I captured component scores and intermediate blending stages for all 2,699 training passages, then analyzed expert disagreements, component removals and cases where blending overrides a correct expert. This includes tracing the existing family specialists.

One negative result may be relevant. Removing a Qwen3-14B score head improved the training proxy but lowered my submission score to 0.649. A confidence-based override using the complementary stack scored 0.643 at a 90% threshold and 0.655 at 98%.

My next step is prompt-held-out evaluation of the style components to see which apparent distinctions survive.
